svg.title: Draw it: the window, the jump, and the ring of zeros
svg.desc: A large empty dashed frame for the student to draw in, with three instructions underneath: draw a row of eight squares numbered from zero with every legal three-wide window start marked; draw the same row with one ring of zeros added and the new count of starts; and write out the division that produced each count, subtract, divide, round down, add one.
svg.text: Draw it: the window, the jump, and the ring of zeros
1. a row of 8 squares numbered from zero, with every legal 3-wide window start marked
2. the same row with one ring of zeros drawn on, and the new count of starts
3. the division behind each count: subtract, divide, round down, add one
